pack.summary: This week, students are exploring the gifts of God in Religion, focusing on Jesus as God's best gift and the Holy Trinity. In Reading, the class is studying stories about families and culture while practicing short vowel sounds and plural noun structures. Students are also preparing for assessments in Religion, Math, and Spelling.
